verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly documents Resources + Suspense for treating server-loaded data as reactive state with a responsive loading UI, and lists streaming SSR/concurrent rendering support (solid-gh-3, solid-gh-4, solid-gh-12). However, a hands-on community report specifically warns against using Suspense in production ('don't ever introduce this and you'll be fine'), a concrete contradiction of the smooth experience implied by vendor docs (solid-comm-12). missing for 10: independent tutorials/benchmarks showing Suspense/Resource working reliably in real apps, resolution of the reported Suspense issues.
